body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy adjacent after your movement.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Move up to 3 units toward a visible enemy. On success, deal 1 Slashing Damage.

surges.html: An adjacent willing ally may move 1 unit toward your destination.
After a hit, move 1 unit without triggering the target's movement Reactions.

rider.title: Full Manifestation - Beast
rider.html: You may burn 3 Action Dice and spend 2 Mana to enter Beast Full Manifestation (FM-1B). It replaces you; use its profile. Dice, Resources, Movement spent and recorded injuries do not refresh.
